tools.name: list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List Tech Faculty departments/tracks with their fees in NGN (one flat fee covering every course; the custom programme is priced per course from the amount shown) and descriptions.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List Tech Faculty service areas beyond courses: business partnerships, school collaborations, events and SIWES. For the 107 pay-per-task business services use list_business_services.

tools.name: list_campuses
tools.title: List campuses
tools.description: List Tech Faculty physical campus locations across Nigeria.

tools.name: list_blog_categories
tools.title: List blog categories
tools.description: List blog categories with slugs, names, and intros.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.title: List blog posts
tools.description: List Tech Faculty blog posts, newest first. Optionally filter by category name and paginate.

category.description: Category name (matches post's primary tag). Discover via list_blog_categories.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.title: Get blog post
tools.description: Fetch a full blog post (markdown content and metadata) by slug.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.title: Search blog
tools.description: Case-insensitive keyword search across blog post titles, descriptions, and tags.

tools.name: list_business_services
tools.title: List pay-per-task business services
tools.description: List Tech Faculty's fixed-price, pay-per-task services for businesses in Nigeria (video editing, social media, field sales reps, website fixes, app testing, cybersecurity, AI automation, virtual assistance), with starting price in NGN, turnaround and order link.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. testing-qa or field-sales.

query.description: Words to match in the service name, summary or keywords, e.g. 'instagram' or 'logo'.

tools.name: list_side_hustles
tools.title: List paid side hustles
tools.description: List Tech Faculty's pay-per-task side hustles for people in Nigeria (₦5,000 or ₦10,000 per approved task, paid weekly every Friday), with what each task needs and how to apply.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. content-creative or field-sales.

query.description: Words to match in the side hustle title, requirements or keywords, e.g. 'video' or 'tester'.

pay.description: Only side hustles paying this many naira per task.

tools.name: list_open_roles
tools.title: List open Tech Faculty roles
tools.description: List open roles on the Tech Faculty jobs marketplace: Tech Faculty team roles, tutors, field reps and client projects in Nigeria (remote and on-site), with pay and the apply link.

query.description: Words to match in the title, summary, skills or city, e.g. 'tutor' or 'Nnewi'.

remoteOnly.description: Only roles that can be done remotely.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.title: Search remote tech jobs
tools.description: Search curated remote tech, AI-training and Nigerian jobs listed on the Tech Faculty careers board (refreshed twice a month), with salary where known and the job page link.

query.description: Words to match in the job title, company, platform or tags, e.g. 'data annotation' or 'python'.

tools.name: list_job_platforms
tools.title: List remote job platforms
tools.description: List the remote work and AI-training platforms (Micro1, Mercor, Outlier, Alignerr and others) Tech Faculty guides Nigerians and Africans to, with what each pays for and the guide page.

tools.name: search_talent_pool
tools.title: Search the talent pool
tools.description: Search Tech Faculty's public talent pool of Nigerian and African tech talent by skill, tool or city, for businesses looking to hire. Returns first names, skills and profile links only; introductions go through Tech Faculty.

query.description: Skills, tools, role or city to match, e.g. 'react developer' or 'video editing Lagos'.

vettedOnly.description: Only talent with a Vetted badge (passed a Tech Faculty assessment or work trial, or a Tech Faculty student/graduate).
